source: Semtech SX1261/2 Data Sheet rev 2.1, section 8.3 SPI interface: SCK up to 16 MHz.

Ebyte E22-900MM22S product specification (LCSC C5333985, 2023-12): NRST active low; TXEN and RXEN are RF switch controls, high level effective; the module uses a 32 MHz passive crystal, so DIO3 does not power a TCXO.
